integrity: The support extension is conditional on the same GRH hypothesis as Ahlquist's theorem. The proof checks stability of each analytic module under fixed local tensor factors; the included code verifies only elementary optimization identities and is not evidence for the Shintani-zeta estimates.
scientific_limitations: The conditioned primes are fixed as \(X\to\infty\), and the statement is restricted to splitting-type conditions defining an \(S_3\)-family. It does not provide uniformity for growing local moduli or identify conditioned lower-order terms.
title: Fixed local splitting conditions preserve support \( <1 \) for cubic Artin one-level density
